en: Points of Controversy The Chapter on Latent Dispositions The Twelfth Section
The Discussion on Restraint and Formal Acts:
Is restraint a formal act? Yes.
Is restraint of the eye-faculty eye-action?
One should not say so … pe … [and similarly for] restraint of the ear-faculty … pe …
Is restraint of the nose-faculty …pe… restraint of the tongue-faculty …pe… restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is bodily restraint bodily action? Yes.
Is the restraint of the eye-faculty eye-action?
One should not say so … [and so on] … Is the restraint of the body-faculty body-action?
“Yes,” he replied.
“Restraint of the ear-faculty … restraint of the nose-faculty …” [and so forth].
Is the restraint of the tongue-faculty the action of the tongue?
One should not say so …pe… is the restraint of the mind-faculty the action of the mind?
It should not be stated thus … [as before] … Is the restraint of the mind-faculty mental action? Yes.
Is the restraint of the eye-faculty eye-action?
One should not say so … [and so on] … Is the restraint of the mind-faculty mind-action?
“Yes, it does.
“Restraint of the ear-faculty … restraint of the nose-faculty … restraint of the tongue-faculty …” [and so on].
Is restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
One should not say so … [as before] … Is non-restraint action?
“Yes.
“Is the non-restraint of the eye-faculty eye-action?
“It should not be said so…” [and so on].
Non-restraint of the faculty of hearing …pe… non-restraint of the faculty of smell …pe… non-restraint of the faculty of taste …pe…
Is the non-restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
One should not say so …pe… Is the non-restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
“Yes.
[The opponent asks: “Is the non-restraint of the eye-faculty an eye-action? [The respondent replies:
“It should not be stated thus,” and so on.
Is non-restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
Yes. Is non-restraint of the ear-faculty [bodily action]? ... [and so on] ... Yes.
Is the non-restraint of the nose-faculty …pe… the non-restraint of the tongue-faculty the action of the tongue?
One should not say so …pe…
Is the non-restraint of the mind-faculty mental action?
One should not say so … [as before] … Is the non-restraint of the mind-faculty mental action?
“Yes.
“Is the non-restraint of the eye-faculty eye-action?
One should not say so … [as before] … “No.”
Is non-restraint of the mind-faculty mental action?
Yes. Is non-restraint of the ear-faculty [mental action]? ...pe... [and so on].
Is non-restraint of the nose-faculty …pe… non-restraint of the tongue-faculty …pe… non-restraint of the body-faculty bodily action?
It should not be said thus...
[as before] ... Should it not be said that "both restraint and non-restraint are kamma"?
“Yes, [he does].
“But was it not said by the Blessed One:
‘Here, monks, having seen a form with the eye, a monk grasps at its signs …’?”
“He does not seize upon signs; having heard a sound with the ear … pe … having cognized a mental phenomenon with the mind,
he does not seize upon signs … pe … he does not seize upon signs.”
Is that indeed the Sutta? Yes.
Therefore, both restraint and non-restraint are karma.
The discussion on restraint and legal proceedings is finished.
